proof_requests: Photo of the rear label showing brand, model, and screen size.
Video of the TV powering on and displaying an image.
Close-up video of the screen on with a white or test pattern.
Photo of the remote control, stand, or wall mount if included.
Video showing HDMI, USB, and other ports working.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a flat-screen television, so a worst-case price is possible; all seller claims about size, brand, and smart features are unverified and priced accordingly.
